title: Payment Application Casebook: Drafts in Flight and the Storage Unit Catch-Up Amount (Bluegate AutoPay Authorization)
content:
**Rule.** On a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the latest submitted draft on the authorization, the draft attempt with the latest draft date, is in flight when it is for a due date later than the returned due date and its result is still empty. Because a payment is applied to the oldest charges first, the unit catch-up amount nets an in-flight draft as follows:

- where **no lien notice fee is posted** for the returned due date, the in-flight draft's submitted amount is **subtracted**, since it will first pay the returned period's charges;
- where **a lien notice fee is posted** for the returned due date, the in-flight draft is refused as a partial payment, so its submitted amount is **added** and the catch-up covers what that draft would have paid;
- where **no draft is in flight**, nothing is netted.

**Which draft.** Only the latest submitted draft is tested, and the returned due date is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date. A latest submitted draft that already has a result, or whose due date is not later than the returned due date, is not in flight, and then no draft is in flight. The lien notice fee is read on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger as a lien notice fee entry whose period is the returned due date.

### Cases (hypothetical figures; amount before netting $260.00)

| Case | Latest draft | Lien notice fee for the returned due date | Netting | Amount after netting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Due 5 May, submitted $150.00, result empty | Not posted | $150.00 subtracted | $110.00 |
| 2 | Due 5 May, submitted $150.00, result empty | Posted | $150.00 added | $410.00 |
| 3 | Due 5 May, result ACH settled | Not posted | Nothing | $260.00 |
| 4 | A re-presentment for 5 March (the returned due date itself), result empty, submitted after a draft due 5 May | Not posted | Nothing — the latest submitted draft is not for a later due date | $260.00 |
